title: DataflowEdgeContribution
description: A dataflow edge (taint propagation, reachability) from a source location/symbol to a sink, lifted from a CPG analyser.

fromSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the source endpoint (must resolve to a SourceUnit.CodeUnit in this Bb).

toSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the target endpoint (must resolve to a SourceUnit.CodeUnit in this Bb).

pathHint.description: Optional textual summary of the propagation path.
